description: This file defines the Content class within the Daux documentation generator project. It manages content parsing, front matter extraction, navigation links, and attribute handling for documentation pages.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Represents a content page in the documentation, handling front matter parsing, navigation, and attribute management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Content object with parent directory, URI, and optional file info.

methods.name: getFrontMatter
methods.description: Parses and retrieves the front matter from the content source.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content string, parsing attributes if necessary.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content manually and marks it as manually set.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous Content object in sequence.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next Content object in sequence.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Checks if the current content is an index page based on URI.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title attribute or falls back to parent method.

methods.name: parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses front matter and content attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute or all attributes.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an array dump of the content including navigation and attributes.
